opponents.name: Mewtwo
opponents.meet_text: ...So. Someone finally found the way in. Do not look so surprised — I have been listening to your footsteps since the forest path. I have no interest in your words. Show me your cards instead.
opponents.repeat_text: You came back. Then you already know how this ends... or perhaps you don't. Show me again.
opponents.first_win_text: ...Enough. You fight better than the ones who built me ever did. Take this — it was here long before the windmill was. Maybe it will mean more to you than it did to me.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Again. There is something in you I have not finished measuring.
opponents.loss_text: As expected. Strength is not something you can simply walk in and claim. Leave, and come back when you have earned it.
